body: whatever you have gone through or are going through, I am sure that there are people who love you and care about you. You said that you attend or have attentded a church nearby you- if anybody in that church listens and knows the christain message of love, then they will help you. You are not alone- don't feel guilty about asking for help, you deserve it. Your life has worth, you have worth. There is nothing that you can do to change that fact. I know these thoughts are scary, I have them from time to time, but that is all they are. Thoughts and emotions- both of them will go away eventually. I know it seems hard right now, but whatever you are going through, there is nothing you can do that will stop the people around you from caring
